name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme as the default with a persistent one-click toggle to light mode. This matches Manus’ competitive analysis and Graphify’s dark interface, ensuring consistency with user expectations and reducing cognitive load. The trade-off is slightly higher initial contrast in dark mode, but it improves readability for extended screen time and aligns with the "liveliness" goal by reducing glare.

name: Pane
text: Dark theme as default still risks users missing critical data if they assume light mode is always available—persistent toggles don’t fix that. A better alternative: default to system preference, with a one-click toggle *and* a clear visual cue (e.g., a faint border) showing the current mode. Settle it with a quick A/B test measuring error rates in data interpretation between the two approaches.
